data.camera: wide shot, standing on an ink-washed crag
data.description: 【夕 · 云中山水】悬浮于九天之上的水墨云山断崖畔，狂风席卷着夕飘逸的玄色宽袍。她伫立在泼墨般的奇峰云海前回眸，身后巨大的青墨龙尾随风摆动——「这山川风月皆是我笔下造物，唯独你……是自己闯进我画里的变数。既然进来了，就老老实实陪我看尽这人间江山吧。」
data.promptProse: Dusk stands on the floating ink-washed crag and looks back over monochrome mountains, wide-sleeved gradient robe and long dragon tail whipping in the wind. Ink-black qipao with teal cloud motifs retains her outfit above bare feet. The wide view places the crag in front of overlapping peaks and the cloud sea. Pale morning sun outlines sleeve and rock edges, while drifting ink mist softens each farther ridge into lighter layers.
data.title: 夕 · 云中山水
